candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return the zero address instead of stored _owner (single-statement replacement of return expression).
Change owner() to return msg.sender instead of stored _owner (single-statement replacement of return expression).
Change owner() to return tx.origin instead of stored _owner (single-statement replacement of return expression).
Removed the zero-address check from transferOwnership so owner can be set to address(0) via transferOwnership (onlyOwner still applies).

Changed onlyOwner to use msg.sender != _owner check directly instead of owner() accessor, which bypasses any override of owner(); this can alter which caller is accepted and thus who may call transferOwnership.
Replace assignment to operator with a no-op (remove state change) so setOperator emits event but does not update operator.
Change assignment to operator to assign to owner() instead of the provided _operator, causing operator to always become the contract owner.
Change assignment to operator to invert bytes of _operator (bitwise NOT) before storing, producing a different operator address than provided.
Modify onlyOwner check to require owner() != _msgSender(), effectively inverting the condition so only non-owners can call functions guarded by onlyOwner, changing who can call setOperator.
Change setOperator to set operator to tx.origin instead of the provided address, so operator becomes the transaction originator.
Replace assignment to rewardsRecipient with assignment only when caller is owner (adds an owner check before setting), so calls by non-owner will leave rewardsRecipient unchanged.
Replace assignment to rewardsRecipient with assignment to zero address (clears recipient regardless of input), so value differs after call.
Replace assignment to rewardsRecipient with a no-op (remove assignment), so calling setRewardsRecipient will not change the stored value anymore.
Modify onlyOwner to revert always (prevent owner from calling setRewardsRecipient), causing setRewardsRecipient calls by owner to fail and not change state.
Modify onlyOwner to allow anyone (remove owner check), so setRewardsRecipient can be called by non-owner and change rewardsRecipient to arbitrary values.
